paper.title: Differential Privacy in the Extensive-Form Bandit Problem

settings.name_in_paper: Extensive-form bandit problem with epsilon-local differential privacy
unmapped: Actions are reduced strategies of a perfect-recall extensive-form game (tree of learner infosets and actions); the learner knows the game tree
Feedback is trajectory-level: user observes the infosets/actions traversed plus the scalar loss
Epsilon-local differential privacy required on the data sent from user to server (eps in (0,1))
Loss of a reduced strategy is lambda(leaf) in [0,1], determined by an a-priori fixed sequence of environments (opponent realisations)
settings.definition_quote: We have $T$ trials. We have a server and for each trial $t\in[T]$ we have a user with an unknown environment $\rft{t}\in\rfs$ fixed a-priori. ... It is required that for each trial $t$, the data sent by the user is $\ep$-\emph{locally differentially private}. ... $\reg := \expt{\sum_{t\in[T]}\lost{t}}-\min_{\st\in\rsts}\sum_{t\in[T]}\loss{\st}{\rft{t}}$

symbols.A_act: total number of learner actions (sum over infosets of available actions)
symbols.S_red: number of the learner's reduced strategies

tuning: eta = ((6 ln T/eps + 9(e-2)/eps^2) A T / ln|S|)^(-1/2)

source.label: mainth
source.quote: \alg\ is $\ep$-locally differentially private and has a regret bound of: \reg\leq 1+2\sqrt{\left(\frac{6\ln(T)}{\ep}+\frac{9(e-2)}{\ep^2}\right)|\acs|\ln(|\rsts|)T}. The per-trial time complexity of \alg\ is in: \mathcal{O}(\max_{\st\in\rsts}\sum_{\anod\in\ran{\st}}\ln(|\ch{\anod}|)). \alg\ requires $\mathcal{O}(|\acs|)$ time to initialise and has a space complexity of $\mathcal{O}(|\acs|)$.

results.notes: Regret against best fixed reduced strategy with oblivious environments, so expected regret equals pseudo-regret here. Also ensures eps-LDP. Lemma 15 is the same bound without the +1 conditioned on a good event; not recorded separately. Abstract summarises as O~(sqrt(A ln(S) T)/eps).
